headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong top‑line gains while others saw modest or slowing expansion.
summary: Coforge led with 53.6% revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech and TCS delivered double‑digit growth supported by AI‑related revenue. Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue outlook to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% growth, the weakest among the peers. Overall, AI themes were prominent, but profit margins varied and some firms faced headcount attrition.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions to top‑line growth, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech noting $219 m AI revenue.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Despite revenue gains, operating margins slipped for some companies, notably Infosys and Wipro, while Coforge improved its margin guidance.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16%.

laggards.why: Only 1.5% YoY revenue growth and cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2%.
